title: T08 — One root command runs NERV and common tests, reusing exact evidence
goal: npm run gauntlet:all from the NERV root plans and runs NERV system packs and every common pack; by default it runs only new, changed or stale cases and reuses evidence whose identity matches exactly
acceptance: Plan shows per case: run (new/changed/stale/identity mismatch) or reuse (report hash, age), with the aggregate time/output budget, before anything runs
Reuse requires the same case hash, model/quantisation/runtime/settings, machine scenario and, for system cases, the NERV source key; any difference reruns the case; --fresh reruns all
NERV deterministic system cases always run (no model, cheap); model cases need explicit --confirm and the reviewed budget
A finished run updates the T07 ledger only from saved, admitted reports
privacy: Neutral synthetic cases and private local reports only; no secrets, downloads or production effects.
validation: Fixtures for reuse, each identity mismatch, max age and --fresh; plan output without model execution
escalation: Default max age for reused model evidence is an owner decision (proposed 30 days)

effort.basis: Owner request 2026-11-11: NERV always consumes every common Gauntlet pack plus its own, and a pack added or changed raises a run-new-tests item. Estimate, not a measurement.
